text: The Marketing Manager wants the sales mix between Individual and Store slash Reseller customers. This page answers that directly, at a glance.

A donut or stacked bar chart shows the mix itself. Two cards give a clean side-by-side dollar comparison. A detail table adds Total Sales, Order Count, and percent of company total for anyone who wants the exact numbers.

Every card and chart on this page gets bound to the plain Total Sales measure, not one of the all-segments or all-territories benchmark measures. The benchmark-based percent measure stays confined to the detail table, where its role is explicit.
With three similarly named Total Sales measures sitting in the Fields pane, it's easy to drag the wrong one onto a card without noticing. This page gets built carefully, with every binding checked.
Next lesson builds the Sales Director's territory page, at a faster pace, which is exactly the condition under which that kind of mistake tends to happen.
